# Top's Pizza

> TOPS Pizza & Sports Bar is a family-owned pizzeria and sports bar at 5602 4 St NW in the Thorncliffe neighborhood of NW Calgary, Alberta, serving hand-tossed pizza, pub food, wings, pastas, Greek classics, and cold drinks from a family recipe in use since 1975.

You can dine in, take out, or order delivery. Delivery is offered to 20+ NW Calgary neighborhoods, and online ordering is available through the restaurant's own ordering page as well as SkipTheDishes and Uber Eats. To order by phone or ask a question, call (403) 275-2722. The venue also runs a full sports bar with many TVs showing NHL, CFL, NFL, MLB, UFC and more, plus daily specials and happy hour.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://topspizza.ca/): TOPS Pizza & Sports Bar overview, ordering options, and what the restaurant offers in NW Calgary.
- [Full Menu](https://topspizza.ca/menu/): Complete menu including pizzas, wings, burgers, pastas, salads, Greek classics, and desserts.
- [Pizzas](https://topspizza.ca/pizza-menu/): Hand-tossed pizzas made fresh daily, with available sizes, toppings, and signature combinations.
- [Daily Specials](https://topspizza.ca/daily-specials/): Daily specials, wing nights, game-day perks, and happy hour offers.
- [Happy Hour](https://topspizza.ca/happy-hour/): Happy hour drink and snack specials at the Thorncliffe location.
- [Sports Bar](https://topspizza.ca/sports-bar/): The sports bar side, with TVs for live games, full bar, pool, jukebox, and VLTs.
- [About](https://topspizza.ca/about/): The family story behind TOPS, owned by the Tsoulamanis family with a recipe in use since 1975.
